Typst template · Doctoral thesis · Print and digital editions

Earthrise Thesis

Template document, built from the latest commit

Digital edition

Symmetric margins, no blank pages

Print edition

Mirrored margins, chapters open on right

Use it

  1. Create a project: typst init @preview/earthrise-thesis:0.1.0 my-thesis
  2. Replace the placeholders in thesis.typ
  3. Compile it: typst watch --font-path fonts thesis.typ

The README explains the fonts, every parameter and reproducible builds. Setup takes about 2 minutes.
